summary: The open issues ordered in release waves by distance from tree-sitter: each wave bumps the packages it names, and the exact-pin cascade carries the bump to everything downstream. Waves 0 and 1 landed as #43-#45 and #49-#51, the gate went back to green with #54 and #56, and CLI hardening landed as #62-#64.

waves.name: Wave 2 — compiler to sdk
waves.goal: compiler and sdk are bumped once, with #14, #7 and #9 fixed and the AgentSession snapshot API on top of the kernel primitive.

items.note: compiler. Needs a maintainer decision before any code: a linter that re-reads the raw text of a parse ERROR node was built and rejected in review — it fired on a valid state-level guide after an unrelated syntax error, hid that error, and missed 128 of 192 generated placements, because tree-sitter recovers the handler differently depending on what follows it. Options: (A) ship only the DA00-09 follow-up lints (W012 extended to guide/teach, W017 duplicate interact, both reviewed correct) and keep #14 open for a grammar-level fix; (B) admit guide/teach in handler bodies in the grammar so parser-dsl and the linter reject them at the exact position — a tree-sitter cascade and an amendment to DA00-09; (C) a conservative text scan that never suppresses E004. Unmerged work: branch fix/issue-14.
cli, not compiler (apps/dot-agent-cli/src/commands/unpack.ts). unpack now restores the source layout by walking the description's merge graph, leaving the description byte-for-byte.

compiler + sdk. W016 is warn-only in packages/compiler/src/pack.ts:333-359, and packages/sdk/src/load.ts classifies by prefix alone. Needs a maintainer decision: whether W016 becomes an error, which breaks pack for anyone who today only gets the warning.

sdk half only. The kernel primitive landed in #51 (serialize_state / restore_state, bound to a behavior fingerprint); what remains is the snapshot and rehydrate API on AgentSession in packages/sdk/src/session.ts. Needs a maintainer decision on its shape: an opaque JSON-serialisable snapshot plus a snapshot option on loadAgent, or exposed state and memory fields that become public contract.

waves.name: Wave 3 — language-server debt
waves.goal: Merge-graph resolution lives in one place in the language server, with a decision recorded on multi-root workspaces.

items.note: Three call sites: features/diagnostics.js:66/86/89/109 and server.js:185-186, no cache, no multi-root. Refactor with no visible symptom; the language server is a leaf.
